note: The National Park Service narrative estimates army strengths of 87,000 Union and 41,000 Confederate soldiers. These include Union reserves, not just soldiers committed to the fighting. Its casualty dataset gives 12,400 Union and 10,320 Confederate killed, wounded, missing or captured, including 2,100 and 1,550 killed respectively. All are historical estimates. Loss proportions use whole-army strength; locations and timing within the animation are illustrative.
